_comment: TinyBatteryNetV1R — MIX_large v2: hyperparameter tuning only. d_model=64 + lstm_layers=1 from base config (fixed).
_rationale: Model architecture is fixed: d_model=64, lstm_layers=1 per summary.md spec.
lr=0.0003: faster initial convergence; plateau scheduler reduces when stalled (fires at max(2,25//2)=12 epochs).
train_epochs=80: ~38 epochs in 8h walltime at 12.5 min/epoch (data-loading bottleneck, not compute).
patience=25: allows LR to halve twice (0.0003→0.00015→0.000075) for fine-grained convergence.
dropout=0.10: mild regularization for large mixed dataset.
batch_size=32: standard for GPU training with 200G RAM.
